units.source_text: 源氏与尚侍胧月夜曾有露情，而终于未得重叙。

en.t: Genji had once shared a secret love with Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami, but in the end he had never been able to meet her again and speak with her at length.

units.source_text: 因此多年以来，对她念念不忘。

en.t: For that reason, through all the years that followed, he could not forget her.

units.source_text: 他常想找个机会同她会面，再叙一次，以便畅谈往事。

en.t: He often thought of finding some chance to meet her, to speak with her once more, and to talk freely about the past.

units.source_text: 然而两人身份都很高贵，必须顾虑世人耳目。

en.t: Yet both of them were of very high rank, and they had to be mindful of the eyes and ears of the world.

units.source_text: 而回想当年轰动一时的须磨事件，源氏一举一动都很谨慎小心了。

en.t: And when he remembered the Suma affair that had caused such a stir in its day, Genji had become cautious and careful in his every action.

units.source_text: 但胧月夜现已闲居寂处，正想出家奉佛，

en.t: But Oborozukiyo was now living quietly in seclusion and was thinking of taking the tonsure and devoting herself to the Buddha,

units.source_text: 源氏颇想知道她的近况，因此比以前更多思念她了。

en.t: so Genji greatly wished to know how she was, and he longed for her even more than before.

units.source_text: 他明知是不应该之事，然而常常以一般慰问为借口，写亲切的信给她。

en.t: Though he knew very well that he ought not to do so, he often used ordinary inquiries after her health as a pretext and sent her affectionate letters.

units.source_text: 胧月夜也以为现在大家已非少年时代，可以不避嫌疑，

en.t: Oborozukiyo, for her part, thought that they were no longer in their youthful days and need not avoid suspicion so strictly,

units.source_text: 所以也常常写回信给他。

en.t: and so she too often wrote replies to him.

units.source_text: 源氏看了她的笔迹，想见其人在各方面都比从前更加饱满圆熟了。

en.t: When Genji saw her handwriting, he imagined that in every respect she had grown fuller and more mature than before.

units.source_text: 他毕竟难于忍耐，便常常写信给胧月夜的侍女，

en.t: In the end he found it hard to endure, and he began writing often to Oborozukiyo's lady-in-waiting,

units.source_text: 就是从前替他们拉拢的中纳言君，向她诉说重重心事。

en.t: the Lady Chuunagon who had once acted as go-between for them, pouring out to her the many layers of feeling in his heart.

units.source_text: 中纳言君有个哥哥，从前曾经当过和泉守的，

en.t: The Lady Chuunagon had an elder brother who had once served as Governor of Izumi,

units.source_text: 源氏把这个人召来，回复了从前年轻时候的态度，对他说道：

en.t: and Genji summoned this man, resumed something of the manner he had had in his younger days, and said to him:

units.source_text: “我希望不要叫人传言，让我隔帘和她直接谈话。

en.t: I do not want people spreading rumors; let me speak with her directly from behind the curtain.

units.source_text: 你去商请她答应了，我就悄悄地前往。

en.t: Go and ask her to agree, and if she does, I will come quietly.

units.source_text: 我现在为身份所羁，不便做此种微行，所以必须十分秘密。

en.t: I am now constrained by my position and cannot easily make this sort of private visit, so it must be kept completely secret.

units.source_text: 想来你也不会泄露出去。

en.t: I trust that you will not let it leak out.

units.source_text: 大家可以放心。”

en.t: Everyone may be at ease.
